reason: Same experiment, stopped nine targets early. The _defb rerun carries all 60 of these question_ids plus 9 more (69 of the 80 false-alarm targets; the other 11 are skipped because the optimiser returned best_query == question, so there is no selection to re-test). _def records also predate fresh_seed stamping, so their seed is asserted by the CLI flag rather than read from the data. Every winner's-curse figure in the paper is a _defb figure.
why_a_sidecar: A .jsonl has no comment syntax and no header, so it cannot carry the '> SUPERSEDED' banner every retired .md in results/ opens with. This file is that banner. scripts/winners_curse_reeval.py reads it via supersession_marker() and refuses (exit 3) rather than rebuilding the canonical report from retired records.

verification.how: Both checkpoints re-scored through scripts/winners_curse_reeval.py:summarize() at its documented defaults (10,000 paired bootstrap replicates, seed 0). _defb reproduces results/winners_curse_se_false_alarm.md and the paper exactly.
verification.note: The retired interval is not obviously wrong on its face -- it is stable, it excludes neither endpoint implausibly, and it rounds to a similar story. That is precisely why the machine gate exists instead of a comment.
